tickets.message: Hi, probably nothing, but I wanted to mention it. My son has been using the insulated bottle we bought in the spring and the inside lining has started flaking. He had a stomach upset this week and the doctor asked what he had been drinking from. Might be unrelated. Just thought you should know.
